verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official CLI (`bolna`), a single Go binary for managing agents, calls, phone numbers and batches from the terminal with no dashboard needed, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of AI-native CLI ergonomics (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output or agent-oriented usage), install/auth/command-reference detail.
